limits: One bounded Notepad type-and-save workflow on this Windows computer; not a universal task or clean-machine certification.
The request was typed; the test used silent microphone input and verified generated completion audio and renderer playback, not human hearing or speech recognition.
The full-chain duration includes application/provider startup, the real brain, approvals and host assistance; it is not comparable to the earlier 11.2-second deterministic-host pilot.
